_comment: Measured decode rates for the section 44 workload matrix, on the pinned model and runtime. eval/traffic_budget.py --matrix turns these into the highest weighted gain any submission could physically earn, and - given the device's persisting-L2 capacity - the much tighter ceiling the persist family is held to. Every rate is a control-arm measurement from ONE box: the ceiling is computed from a measured step time, clocks cannot be pinned in this container, and two RTX 5090s this project used disagreed by 2.6% at concurrency 16. Mixing boxes would put that disagreement inside the number.
_persisting_l2_bytes_note: persisting_l2_max_bytes as queried from the device by tools/info.cpp (recur_local_info): 60 MiB of a 96 MiB L2.

batch1.source: results/rtx5090-baseline-concurrency.json, control arm, mean of 3 interleaved repeats on one box; single-sequence decode keeps the fp32 matrix state
